runs.candidate: Remove duplicated New Meeting recording-state polling
runs.evidence: 60s lifecycle, 2 warmups, 7 measured iterations; 182 to 121 IPC calls.
Native recording_duration and active_duration advance every 500ms; representative active lifecycle reduced commits by only 0.83% (121 to 120), below a credible product-level win.

runs.candidate: Consolidate main-window and Flow Bar recording providers
runs.evidence: The Flow Bar is a separate WebView and requires its own provider; removing it breaks synchronization boundaries. Required polling remains 120 + 120.

runs.candidate: Serialize summary polling with a completion-aware timer
runs.evidence: Representative 60s workload with 5s cadence and 500ms response produced 12 requests either way and no overlap.

runs.candidate: Replace transcript streaming interval with a different timer
runs.evidence: Representative 240-character segment preserved 48 visible-text updates; no work reduction without changing the streaming experience.

runs.candidate: Reduce RecordingStateContext polling cadence from 500ms to 1000ms
runs.evidence: Would reduce polls by 50% (120 to 60 per minute) but violates the existing 500ms duration/state feedback contract.

limitations: Runs 2-6 are deterministic workload audits and rejection proofs; they intentionally made no source changes.
Native runtime recording QA was not rerun after the hook-only optimization.
